title: Influence lower bound for balanced linear thresholds
statement: Let $f:\\{−1,1\\}^n\\to\\{−1,1\\}$ be balanced and representable as a linear threshold function, with $n\\ge1$. Then some coordinate $i$ has influence at least $1/\\sqrt{2n}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the sign cube
$f$ is balanced, meaning its uniform mean is zero
